result.instructions: Tools for Cezanne HR, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Who joined our company in the last 30 days, and in which org unit?"; "How many absence events were recorded for the sales team this quarter?"; "Show the current primary employment of person CEZ01.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Cezanne HR data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run cezannehr_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run cezannehr_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run cezannehr_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. cezannehr_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: cezannehr_list_people
tools.title: List people
tools.description: List people in Cezanne HR, including leavers and new hires unless active_only is true. Returns one page; use next_skip to read more. OData: People.

skip.description: Rows to skip, for paging (default 0). Use the reply's next_skip.

select.description: Comma-separated fields to return, for example FamilyName,FirstName.

tools.name: cezannehr_get_person
tools.title: Get person
tools.description: Get one person by Person Code, optionally with selected fields. OData: People('<code>').

person_code.description: The person's Person Code, for example CEZ01.

select.description: Comma-separated fields to return, for example FamilyName,FirstName.

tools.name: cezannehr_get_current_employment
tools.title: Get current primary employment
tools.description: Get the current primary employment of one person by Person Code. OData: People('<code>')/PeopleToEmploymentCurrentPrimary.

person_code.description: The person's Person Code, for example CEZ01.

skip.description: Rows to skip, for paging (default 0). Use the reply's next_skip.
